summary: Sheriff's deputies booked a Baldwin County man on drug-trafficking, drug-distribution and firearm charges, and arrested a man on stolen-property and drug charges. The jail roster shows 49 admits dated Oct. 28; the sheriff's office says a missing 18-year-old it sought this week has been located. Foley police said Thursday evening they arrested a Foley High School student who claimed to have a firearm on campus; no gun was found.

entries.title: Drug-trafficking and firearm arrest: Michael Ace Salter
body: Michael Ace Salter, 22, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 3 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, and booked into the county jail Wednesday, Oct. 28, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on charges of drug trafficking, two counts of sale or distribution of dangerous drugs, being a drunk or drug addict in possession of a firearm — a person barred from having a gun by drug or alcohol use — and tampering with physical evidence, meaning destroying or hiding evidence. He was in custody when the roster was read Thursday morning.

The roster also shows a booking for Michael Ace Salter, 22, on Oct. 22 by sheriff's deputies, on charges of synthetic narcotic possession and being a drunk or drug addict in possession of a firearm; that record shows a release.

entries.title: Stolen-property and drug arrest: Bryan Lardor Soles
body: Bryan Lardor Soles, 31, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 12:15 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on charges of buying or receiving stolen property — taking property knowing it was stolen — possession of dangerous drugs and first-offense drug paraphernalia. He was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: School threat arrest: Foley High School student
body: Foley police said a Foley High School student was arrested Thursday, Oct. 29, after claiming to have a firearm on campus. Police and school resource officers searched several areas of the school and did not find a firearm, according to the department's account reported by NBC 15.
Police did not name the student or state the charge. The case is being handled by the Juvenile Court of Baldwin County.

entries.title: Family-violence arrests: Joshua Kyle Marques Hall, Skylar Devon Jemison
body: Sheriff's deputies made two arrests on family-violence charges Tuesday evening, Oct. 27, according to the jail roster; both were booked Wednesday, Oct. 28.

Joshua Kyle Marques Hall, 28, was arrested at 7:54 p.m. and booked on a charge of simple assault against a family or household member. Skylar Devon Jemison, 20, was arrested at 10:45 p.m. and booked on a charge of harassment of a family or household member. Both were in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Erik Stephen Smith
body: Erik Stephen Smith, 52, was arrested by sheriff's deputies Wednesday, Oct. 28, according to the jail roster, which gives no arrest time.
He was booked on a charge of third-degree assault — causing physical injury to another person. He was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Drug possession arrests: Orange Beach and Foley
body: Orange Beach and Foley police each made a drug-possession arrest Tuesday evening, Oct. 27, according to the county jail roster; both people were booked Wednesday, Oct. 28.

Jessica Louise Risinger, 49, was arrested by Orange Beach police at 8:45 p.m. and booked on charges of possession of dangerous drugs, illegal possession of prescription drugs and first-offense drug paraphernalia. Stephen Michael Wyatt, 30, was arrested by Foley police at 10:40 p.m. and booked on charges of possession of dangerous drugs and first-offense drug paraphernalia. Both were in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Missing person located: Miles Cubbage, 18
body: The Baldwin County Sheriff's Office has updated its Oct. 27 request for help finding Miles Cubbage, 18, to say he has been located. The post gives no further details.
